confidence: Low to moderate. Death after the toast and an opened cyanide bottle supply a plausible mechanism, but do not yet connect any individual to administration.
plausibility_notes: Post-death bottle examination and before/after condition photographs are believable investigative evidence.
Locked storage does not establish continuous security during the walkthrough, and the split band can be assessed without treating it as magical proof.
The exact dose, route, and person handling the donor glass are still unknown.
